checks.name: every reviewed listing, and only those
no listing without a review
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.listing_review_summary where listing_id not in (select listing_id from raw.reviews) or review_count is null or review_count = 0 or avg_rating is null

checks.name: no review of a removed listing
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.listing_review_summary where listing_id not in (select listing_id from raw.listings)

checks.name: review counts and ratings match
checks.sql: select count(*) from main.listing_review_summary s join (select r.listing_id, count(*) as n, avg(r.rating) as a from raw.reviews r join raw.listings l using (listing_id) group by 1) e using (listing_id) where s.review_count is distinct from e.n or abs(s.avg_rating - e.a) > 1e-9
